g.title: XD10_ESC
g.text: TH SIG (throttle, plugs into receiver TH=CH2)
BEC VCC (5–7.4V out to receiver and servos)
Manual: hobbywing.com/en/uploads/file/20221012/7cb44bc6cf370ca8bb8ac96c29b6a7e3.pdf BEC: "adjustable from 5V to 7.4V (step: 0.1V)" per features list. Do NOT connect separate BEC to receiver.

g.title: W_ESC_TH
g.text: XD10_ESC:1:TH SIG (throttle, plugs into receiver TH=CH2)
XD10_ESC:2:BEC VCC (5–7.4V out to receiver and servos)
XD10 Pro throttle + BEC cable to receiver CH2.

g.title: R7FG_RX
g.text: 7-channel, 2.4GHz; CH7/SBUS used for DP-302 V4 dual gain
CH3 SIG (optional: DP-302 gain or free)
CH7/SBUS (S.BUS output for DP-302 dual gain)

R7FG manual: radiolink.com.cn/download/3edba11a28636d2f5f2f6002d04a92aa.pdf R7FG built-in gyro = OFF (factory default) — must stay OFF with external gyro. CH7 outputs S.BUS when S.BUS mode enabled (short press binding button once). LED indicator: Green=PWM, Blue=SBUS, Red=Gyro mode, Purple=Gyro+SBUS. BEC supply from XD10 Pro ESC.

g.title: W_CH1_Y
g.text: GYRO_DP302V4:1:CH1 in (steering, from receiver via Y-cable)
Y-cable: receiver CH1 → DP-302 V4 CH1 + Killerbody CH1.

g.title: W_CH2_Y
g.text: Y-cable: receiver CH2 → XD10 ESC + Killerbody CH2.

g.title: W_CH7_SBUS
g.text: R7FG_RX:7:CH7/SBUS (S.BUS output for DP-302 dual gain)
GYRO_DP302V4:3:CH3 in (optional 3-ch gain — see R7FG CH3 conflict note)
CH7 S.BUS output from R7FG to DP-302 V4 CH3 input for dual gain control.

g.title: GYRO_DP302V4
g.text: 4-mode: Normal/ASSIST × Hard/Soft gain. SBUS dual gain.
CH1 in (steering, from receiver via Y-cable)
CH3 in (optional 3-ch gain — see R7FG CH3 conflict note)

Manual: teamyokomo.com/downloadfiles/.../DP-302V4_User_manual.pdf (scanned image PDF) SW1: up=Normal, down=ASSIST (default=Normal). SW2: Normal/Reverse servo direction. Dual gain via S.BUS (CH7 on R7FG): −100%→0 = Hard Mode (red LED, beginners); 0→+100% = Soft Mode (green LED, expert). Hard Mode recommended to start. LED status: Red fast flash=initializing; Green fast=signal loss; Red solid=Normal gain; Green solid=AVCS gain; Yellow slow=stroke setting; Off=0% gain.

g.title: W_GYRO_SERVO
g.text: DP-302 V4 servo output to steering servo.

g.title: KB48102_LED
g.text: Reads CH1 steering (Y) + CH2 throttle (Y). Not all radios compatible.
KB48102 instruction sheet: killerbodyrc.com/Prod_image/instructions/48102.PDF Bench-test R7FG compatibility before permanent install.

g.title: SERVO_ST
g.text: Steering servo (driven by DP-302 V4 output)
